tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅/ /lam dus kyi dbang bskur ba dang / gso ba dang / bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len rnams bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kyai rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba'i tshul la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ gnas dben par phyag dar byas te/ bla ma la sogs pa'i rten ji ltar 'os pa'i sar bzhugs su gsol ba'i drung du/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / gtor ma lnga tshul bzhin du bsham/ bla re la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes par bya/ rnam par rgyal pa'i bum pa cho ga bzhin du bsham/ 'og tu slob ma la dgos pa'i gdong g.yogs dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / dbu rgyan dang / rdo rje dril bu rnams slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ ji tsam 'byor pa bsham mo/ /slob dpon rang nyid kyi mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu rnams kyang bsham/ de las gzhan tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang / ras bris la sogs pa rnams ni 'dir mi dgos gsung ngo / /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi bya ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa/ bum pa bzlas pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ dam tshig can la gtor ma dbul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rim yan lag drug pa lus dkyil dang bcas pa bsgoms nas/ lam dus kyi dbang blangs te bzlas pa cung zad byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdus la rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du lha dgu bskyed pa nas lha zhu ba'i bar dbang gi chu bo ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi steng du rnam rgyal bum pa dang / dbu rgyan dang / rdo rje dril bu dang / maṇḍal me tog dang bcas pa rnams bzhag ste/

yid kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas pa'i lus la lus dkyil gyi lha rnams tshang bar bzhugs pa mngon sum ltar dmigs nas/ de'i mdun du maṇḍal phul te dga' chen khyod bdag gis gsol ba gdab pa nas dbang bzhi pa rdzogs kyi bar 'og tu slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba ltar rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ gtor ma dang po mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel ba'i lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad kyi tshogs 'das pa la dbul/ gnyis pa nag po chen po lcam dral/ gsum pa gdong bzhi pa/ bzhi pa pu tra ming sring / lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul la/ rdo rje'i glu bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rang nyid kyis rgyu dus kyi dbang gis smin par byas pa rnams bos te/ khrus byas gral du 'khod pa la me tog bkram pa bsdus nas/ rgyu dus dang / lam dus dang / 'bras dus kyi dbang rnams gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga gang las bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi go ba legs par bshad nas/ de rnams kyi nang nas 'dir lam dus kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul zhes brjod la 'bul du gzhug de nas dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung nas/ sngon chad lus kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar ras yug dmar pos gdong bcing / lus dkyil gyi gtso bo thugs rdo rje dang mjal ba la lag stong du mjal mi nyan pas me tog gi phreng ba re lag tu gtad/

lus dkyil gyi thugs rdo rje'i thugs ka nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dpag tu med pa spros te dbang bskur ba zab mo zhu ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad bskrad par bsams la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod/ bum chu gtor ba 'dir mi mdzad/ de nas 'dod pa dri zhing lan gdab pa dang / sems bskyed pa dang / gsang bar gdams pa gsum ni dbang chu ltar bya'o/ /de nas bla ma'i lus la gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i mdun du phyin par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pa ni phyi'i 'jug pa'o/ /nang gi 'jug pa la sngon 'gro dam la gzhag pa bzhi ni dbang chu bzhin bya'o/ /dngos gzhi byin rlabs kyi rim pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab nas/ byin rlabs kyi rim pa la lnga yod pa'i dang po brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas pa/ sku la lus dkyil gyi lha tshang bar bzhugs pa'i spyi bor bla ma dam pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan nas birwa pa'i bar dang / de'i spyi bor sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / de thams cad kyang kyai rdo rje nas tshang bar bzhugs pa'i bar snga ma ltar brjod la/ rang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bla ma so so'i sku la gnyis su med par thim pas/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos shing / gus 'dud drag pos gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems/ rlung sems mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu'i dwangs ma/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i ngo bo/ sku bzhi'i sa bon dga' ba bzhi'i rang bzhin/ dbang bzhi'i chu bo thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid de dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug yab yum la thim/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis nag po pa la thim pa nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pa'i bar du dmigs pa byed du bcug la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de bla ma brgyud pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu dbang gi chu bo rnams 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos la gus 'dud drag pos gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas rtsa ba'i bla ma kyai rdo rje yab yum snyoms par zhugs nas dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs mdzad pa phrin las dang khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum byed las rnams dbyer med cing bla ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu dbang gi chu bo rnams 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsgoms la/ de'i tshe rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad lus la sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de'i tshe slob ma gu gul gyi dud pas bdug bla mas lus kyis dril bu dkrol zhing / ngag tu sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi mtshan nas brjod de/ bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang / skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

des bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi yon tan phrin las byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad dang mnyam par byas pa ni bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pas byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa lha'i rim pas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ khyed rnams dngos po dang mtshan ma gang la'ang ma zhen pa'i ngang nas/ kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas pa langs nas yod pa'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa'i 'og tu nas/ has mtshan pa'i bar dbang chu ltar gsal gdab la/ de nas bla ma la gus 'dud drag po byas te/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos pas dzhaiṃ mer gyur pa de long bu'i rtsa nas yar zhugs/ sum mdo'i me dang 'dres pas rkyen byas nas mun khung du sgron me bteg pa ltar lus kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje nas/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi skur gyur ces pa'i bar gsal gdab/ slar yang sum mdo'i me la sems gtad pas me cher 'bar te/ snying ga'i sa yang tsha lam gyis bsregs pas mgrin pa'i chu skya thol gyis bskol/ de'i drod kyis spyi bo'i haṃ bzhus te rtsa sbubs nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa mgrin pa'i chu la thim/ de las bdud rtsi 'dzag pa snying ga'i sa la thim/ de ltar na yas mar bdud rtsi 'dzag pas bde ba/ mas yar me 'bar bas drod skyes te snying gar bde drod 'dzom pa la sems mnyam par bzhag la/ de ltar lus drod dang bde ba'i rang bzhin kyai rdo rje yab yum du langs nas yod pa'i rkang 'og gi rlung gis gyen la bteg sogs nas/ hūm̐ ā ha dzhaiṃ bar brjod cing dril bu dkrol rdzas kyis bdug pa dbang chu bzhin bya ba ni lha'i rim pas byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /gsum pa sngags kyi rim pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus kyi lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po/

de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo byang sems dmar pos gang ba/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo byang sems dkar pos gang ba gsum gshibs nas yod pa lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lte bar aṃ dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po mgo thur bstan/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i lte bar oṃ dmar po mgo gyen bstan/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte bar haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan rnams gsal btab cing / bla ma la gus 'dud drag po byas pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas spyi bo nas bshang sgo'i rlung dang 'dres shing g.yos pas lte ba'i aṃ bskul bas me 'bar/ de las me shin tu phra ba dbu ma nas yar song / snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bcom/ spyi bo'i haṃ la bsnun/ haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ mgrin pa'i oṃ gsal btab pas dga' ba/ de las rgyun babs snying ga'i hūm̐ gsal btab pas mchog dga'/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun lte bar babs pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa dang lte ba'i aṃ gis me 'bar ba/ 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad lus la sib kyis thim zhing rang byung gi ye shes bde ba chen po'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs par mos/ oṃ āḥ.a ā nas/ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol lo/ /de ni sngags kyi rim pas byin gyis brlab pa'o zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa ye shes kyi rim pa ni khyed rang rnams phyi'i he ru ka yab yum dang nang gi 'khor lo lnga'i gtso bo yab yum lnga snyoms par zhugs/ gtum mo'i mes spyi bo'i haṃ bzhus pa'i byang sems kyi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad khyab pas yan lag gi lha thams cad kyang bde ba'i rang bzhin du byas/

rgyud la bde ba chen po'i rtogs pa khyad par can skyes/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyai rdo rje'i rnam pas lus la sib kyis thim zhing bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin byin gyis brlab par mos/ oṃ de wā nas phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol/ de ni sems bde ba chen po'i rim pas byin gyis brlab pa'o zhes brjod do/ /lnga pa de kho na nyid kyi rim pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid bde ba chen po'i ngar dang ldan pa de snying gar hūm̐ gi rnam par bsgoms pa la sems gtad pas hūm̐ gis zhabs kyu ha la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de yang bde chen de kho na nyid kyi ngang du thim pa'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sib kyis thim zhing / bde chen de kho na nyid du byin gyis brlabs par mos/ oṃ āḥ.a ā nas phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol/ de ni de kho na nyid kyi rim pas byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /zhes brjod de thams cad la gu gul gyi dud pas bdug go /de ltar byin rlabs kyi rim pa lnga las rim pa dang po ni spyir btang ba yin la/ phyi ma bzhi ni rim pa ltar rgyu dus kyi dbang bzhi'i ye shes bzhi po de 'bebs pa'i man ngag go /zhes gsungs te/ 'dis lam dus kyi dbang la rgyu dus kyi dbang bzhi char sngon du 'gro dgos par grub cing / de ltar na rim pa dang po ni rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bo de nyid lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bor bsgyur ba'i man ngag yin nam snyam mo/ /de brtan par bya ba'i phyir slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ tiṣṭha badzra brjod cing / bla ma'i sku la gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha rnams bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa yab yum sngar phyi dkyil du me tog phul ba'i gtso bo dang dbyer med du dmigs pa'i dbu la phul bar mos la me tog phul zhing oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ

zhes brjod cing bla ma'i phyag tu me tog gtad/ bla mas kyang me tog gnang ba'i tshul gyis khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ pra tī gṛhṇa swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā bā la/ zhes brjod cing me tog mgor bzhag cing / oṃ rdo rje nas bla na med kyis gdong ras bsal la des snod rung du byas nas/ thar pa chen po'i nas brtson par gyis zhes pa'i bar brjod cing bla ma'i rten lus dkyil dang / brten pa lus rtsa la gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs ci ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul dang / dkyil 'khor gzhan gsum la'ang gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs ci ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad nas de ltar khyed rnams kyis bla ma'i sku la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong bar ma zad/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la'ang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor yod par mthong ba yin pas/ deng phyin chad zhag gcig la rab thun bzhi/ 'bring thun gsum/ tha ma thun gnyis/ shin tu tha shal gyis kyang thun gcig la phyi nang gi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom zhing mchod bstod la brtson par gyis shig de rnams ni 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba la bzhi'i dang po bum dbang la gnyis kyi dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul cig de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes nas bdag la stsol bar de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams bla ma'i mdun du dbang stegs rin po che'i khrir gnas pa'i steng du gdugs/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu/ 'khor dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas bzhugs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/

khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / bum chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las zhes sogs rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / thun mong rdo rje brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams dbang chu bzhin du bskur la/ 'on kyang khyad par ni dbang rdzas dang slob ma lhar bskyed pa rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed/ mi bskyod pa'i chu dbang ma gtogs par mtha' rten gyi chu dbang gzhan rnams la bum chu ku sha'i rtse mos 'thor ba tsam mdzad/ rjes gnang la sogs pa'i mtha' rten ni gang yang mi dgos so/ /de nas dbang gong ma gsum ni mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten nas bskur ba'i yig cha ji lta ba bzhin du bskur la/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin par khas blang du gzhug slob mas yon dang maṇḍal phul la/ deng nas brtsams te sogs kyis lus dang longs spyod thams cad cha shas kyis dbul/ slob ma rnams la lam dus kyi dbang thun bzhi la sogs pa len dgos tshul dang / rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dbye ba brjod de rang gnas su gtang ngo / /gsum pa rjes ni/ de nas slob dpon gyis yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs bdag la bsdus la skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas chos 'chad pa la sogs pa'i bya ba gzhan la 'jug par bya'o/ /'di 'dra'i chos tshul 'doms par byed pa po/ /dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ /rang sems dpal gyi don dang 'dres gyur nas/ /yon tan bzang po'i gter la spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i gsung las ji ltar zin pa dang / phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa ltar/ rang nyid dran pa gso ba'i ched du/

shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges bris pa'o// //dge'o// // ༄༅/ /na mo badzra ḍā kā ya/ lam dus kyi dbang gso ba'i phyag len ni/ gnas dben par mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ slob dpon bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed/ dam tshig can la gtor ma ster ba'i bar du byas nas/ slob ma rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang sngar thob zin pa rnams bos te/ gral du 'khod pa la 'dir snyan brgyud bzhi'i nang nas dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa la/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa dang / lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa gnyis las/ lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo sngar thob zin nas/ cung zad chag pa rnams la gso ba'i cho ga rje btsun gyis dbang gi rab dbye nas 'jug pa yan chad dor te/ de'i tshab tu rigs lnga'i sdom gzung byas nas/ dngos gzhi rig pa'i dbang lnga man chad bskur bar gsungs pa ltar sgrub pa lags/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma la bya ba gnyis yod pa las/ dang po tshar nas gnyis pa'i don du maṇḍal phul zhes brjod la/ maṇḍal 'bul du bcug nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab tu gzhug de nas bla ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi dbang gis/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang 'gal ba dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang / bla ma dang yi dam la ma gus pa dang / bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la g.yel ba dang /

mchod pa dang gtor ma la ma brtson pa la sogs pa sdig pa/ sgrib pa/ nyes pa/ ltung ba/ dri ma'i tshogs thams cad bla ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang sdom par bgyid lags so/ /zhes pa lan gsum dang / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum rnams kyi rjes zlos byed du bcug la/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang / zla ba/ nyi ma/ bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du bla ma rnams kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum dang bcas pa steng nas steng du brtsegs par bsgoms pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams spyan drangs nas bla ma so so la thim par bsgoms la/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis zhes brjod de/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas bla ma gong ma rnams snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i chu rgyun gyis 'og ma 'og ma rnams la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis thim pa'i dmigs pa rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byed du bcug nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dbang gi chu bo thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab tu gzhug go /de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs te byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i chu rgyun gyis/

slob ma la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis thim pa'i dmigs pa byed du gzhug la/ slob dpon gyis dril bu dkrol te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang zhes sogs bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la byin gyis brlabs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ma skyes pa skye ba dang / skyes pa brtan pa dang / gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan mang du brjod/ de'i rkyen gyis rten dang brten pa'i lus dkyil gsal btab la/ de nas dngos gzhi rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba man chad kyi dmigs pa rnams bla mas spod/ slob ma rnams kyis 'dzin cing / gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig rnams dang shes rab ye shes kyi skabs su rig ma la lan gdab pa rnams ni rjes zlos dngos su byed/ maṇḍal rnams ni dngos su 'bul/ dbang rdzas dngos su 'grim pa ni med/ de nas mjug yon 'bul ba yan chad byas la slob ma rnams dga' ba bskyed de rang gnas su gtang / de nas slob dpon gyis gtor mgron la nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang / ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus te skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa rnams bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje bla ma mus pa chen po'i gsung las ci ltar zin pa bzhin du rab 'byams pa puṇye siṃ has bris pa/ e waṃ chos ldan du sa stag nag pa'i nyer gsum la'o// //dge'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshul la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ dus khyad par can nyi shu dgu'am/ gnam stong gang rung la gnas dben par rten gyi drung du/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / gtor ma lnga tshul bzhin du bsham/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi mdun du nang mchod dang /

rdo rje dril bu'ang bsham mo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma la byin rlabs bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te kyai rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par byas nas/ gtor ma dang po lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad kyi cho gas 'das pa la 'bul/ gnyis pa nag po chen po lcam dral/ gsum pa gdong bzhi pa/ bzhi pa pu tra/ lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul lo/ /de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba thun mong ma yin pa bsgom zhing / bsrung ba rnams kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni slob ma lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid rdzogs par thob pa bos te/ khrus byas/ maṇḍal phul nas gral du 'dug pa la/ 'di'i rjes zlos byed du bcug ste/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /lan gsum/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas rgyun bshags lan gsum/ rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas byin rlabs dngos gzhi ni/ bla ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug zhal phyag 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bsgom du bcug la/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ brla rtsar hā ljang gu rnams bsgoms la/ de nas dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad bkug nas oṃ la thim pas/ oṃ de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsgoms nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos byed du bcug ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ bla ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun oṃ gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa byung ste slob ma'i spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/

lus kyi dri ma thams cad dag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad thob par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥlas gsang ba'i dbang thob pa dang / thugs ka'i hūm̐ las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'ang des rigs 'gre'o/ /yang bla ma'i lte ba'i swā dang / brla'i hā las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dang phrin las thams cad bkug nas yi ge gnyis la thim pas yi ge gnyis po de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan phrin las thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsgoms la/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos byed du bcug ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis bdag la dbang bzhi pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ yi ge gnyis las bdud rtsi'i rgyun yi ge gnyis kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa byung ste slob ma'i lus thams cad la thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs thob par bsam mo/ /de nas bla ma 'od du zhu nas slob ma'i lus la thim pas slob ma de padma dang zla ba nyi ma kṛṣṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan gyi steng na/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa'i rtse mo bkug pas nyi ma mnan pa/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu dpag bsam gyi shing bzang po la sku rgyab brten pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku shin tu grims pa/ zhal dang spyan gnyis bgrad pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras shing / me tog sna tshogs kyis thod bcings pa zhig tu bsgom du gzhug go /de nas srung ba gnyis thun mong ba nas bshad pa ltar skyed de/ de dag ni byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi'o/

/de'i rjes su rnal 'byor ma chag par bsgom pa'i tshul chos kyi rjes mdzad pa'i yig cha las 'byung ba ltar bshad nas/ yon dang maṇḍal 'bul du bcug ste rang gnas su gtang ngo / /gsum pa rjes ni/ de nas bla mas gtor mgron la lhag chad kha bskang ba dang / nongs pa bzod par gsol te ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa rnams bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje bla ma mus pa'i gsung las ji ltar zin pa bzhin du sprang btsun bsod nams seng ges bris pa'o// //dge'o// ༈ /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs bzhugs// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par skyang nul re khās zlum por bskor ba'am/ 'khar ba la sogs pa'i maṇḍal khru gang las mi chung ba'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad/ shar gyi shar dang / nub kyi nub rnams su gtso bo dang / khro bcu'i tshom bu bcu gcig dgod/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi'i tshom bu tshang bar 'god de/ ma shong na nas rdog re res kyang 'god do/ /de'i mtha' skor du chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyai rdor bzhin dang / byang shar du gtor ma bsham/ bum pa gcig spyi dang mthun par bsham/ slob dpon rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu rnams bsham/ de nas mchod pa bsang sbyang kyai rdor dang 'dra bar byas nas 'di'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya ste dkyil 'khor bsdus la rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyang byas nas lha bdun cu rtsa lnga bdag bskyed bzhin yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/

nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod nas/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyang / a kā ros byin gyis brlabs nas sngags ring tshar gsum gyis dbul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas bum pa'i bskyed chog dang bzlas pa sgrub thabs ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang gis smin pa rnams khrus byas/ yon dang maṇḍal phul te gral la 'khod pa la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs tshigs rkang drug dang / kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum du gdab tu gzhug gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags byas nas bla ma rdo rje rnam par 'joms par gsal ba'i thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rlung phyir rgyu ba dang mthun pa'i hūm̐ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ slob ma'i rlung nang du 'jug pa dang mthun par snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ lus kyi nang gang bas pa spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros gnas khang dang yul la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang bar bsgoms/ yang thugs ka nas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ snga ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ gu gul gyi dud pa dang / hūm̐ nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod cing / dril bu'i sgra dang bcas te/ mi chod pa/ mi shig pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ zhes brjod pa'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la tiṣṭha badzra gyis brtan par bya'o/ /de nas maṇḍal phul te/ byang chub rdo rjes sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma rdo rje cho ga gsum las rdo rje rnam par 'joms par bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bcug nas slob dpon gyis bum pa bzung ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/

/zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas dbang gi lha rnams bstims te/ su pra tiṣṭha zhes sogs kyis rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /de nas gong 'og gi tshig rnams lan re bklag gzungs ring tshar gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du bcug nas spyi bor me tog gzhag go /de nas bla ma rang 'od kyi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' nas thig le dkar dmar slob ma'i mgrin pa'i nang du thim/ lus thams cad gang bas gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsgom du gzhug yang slob ma rang 'od kyi rig ma dang / thabs shes rab gnyis med kyi sbyor ba byas par bsgoms la pad skor dang bcas pa'i 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsgom/ de nas zag bcas kyi bde ba de zag med stong pa gzung 'dzin dang bral ba chu zla lta bur bsgoms pas dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam mo/ /de nas gtang rag gi maṇḍal dbul du gzhug go /gsum pa rjes ni kyai rdor dang mthun no/ /zhes pa 'di ni gong ma'i tho yig gi steng du bla ma'i phyag len bzhin bsod nams seng ges bris pa'o// //dge'o// ༈ /ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i mgon po dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// ༈ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i gur gyi mgon po'i rjes su gnang ba bya tshul ni/ mdun du maṇḍal dri bzang gis byug pa'i steng du nas nag po'i tshom bu gcig dgod/ de'i mdun du chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma che ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa gcig bsham/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyai rdo rje dang 'dra/ bdag bskyed gur rgyan nas 'byung ba ltar gyi nag po chen po yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas bzlas pa bya/

mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las nag po chen po bdag bskyed ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod/ nang bdud rtsis mchod/ bstod pas kyang bstod/ gtor ma kyai rdor ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan gsum dang / sngags ring lan gsum gyis dbul/ slar yang phyi mchod dang / nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gsung ngag gi khrid kyis smin pa cig bos la khrus byas/ yon dang maṇḍal phul nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /sogs tshigs rkang drug dang / kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ de nas slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las padma dang / nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer spros bsdus yongs su gyur pa las/ nag po chen por bskyed pa dpon slob gnyis char gyis dmigs pa bya/ de'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug gi tshe rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas nag po chen po spyan drangs nas slob ma la bstim par dmigs nas rol mo bya/ slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab nas/ dbang gi lha rnams bstim te spyi bor me tog zhag nas rab tu gnas par bya ste/ de ltar slob ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya ba ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /de nas sngags thung dang sngags ring gnyis kyi bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ni spyi dang mthun/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ngo sprod nas/

de'i ngang la gzhag pa'o/ /de nas slob ma'i mgor gtor ma gzhag slob dpon gyis phreng ba slob ma'i mgul du bskon pa la slob dpon gyi phyag gis 'jus nas/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod de/ de dag gi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar zhes sogs rjes gnang spyi'i bka' bsgo dang / khyad par gsung ngag rin po che nyams su len pa la 'jig rten chos kyi bar chad/ phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad/ bdud stobs 'phel ba'i bar chad rnams mi 'byung zhing / khams 'dus pa gsum mthar phyin nas/ tshe 'di nyid la grub mtha' snyogs pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub tu gsol/ rang sgrub pa mthar phyin nas snod ldan gyi gdul bya la dbang gi smin par byas nas/ khrid dang gdams pa tshul bzhin du bstan pa'i sgo nas/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bka' bsgo bya/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang mthun no// //'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun bla ma kun dga' bzang po yan chad gsung ngag brgyud pa dang mthun la/ de nas chos kyi rje kun dga' dbang phyug des bdag bsod nams seng ge la'o/ /'di'i sgrub pa dang / las sbyor rnams gur rgyan na bzhugs pa de nyid yin cing / phyag mtshan la gaṇḍi med par gsungs la/ zhabs kyi bzhugs tshul zhi ba la g.yas brkyang / drag po la g.yon brkyang / dbang la sa ga rgyas pa la zlum po bya bar gsungs so/ /bdag mdun gang la'ang dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i tshe sa bon tsam las bskyed pa'am/ rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed pa ni gang byas kyang 'dra ba nyid do/ /dge ba 'di yis dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa ni/ /dar rgyas yun du 'bar gyur cig /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 go bo rab 'byams pa/
